CLOCA Conceptual Floodplain Mapping

*Note: All floodplains and spill locations are conceptual.

Search by address to determine if you might be vulnerable to mapped areas of river, stream and Lake Ontario-based flooding. The Floodplain Public Viewer gives the public the ability to find out whether their property is located within a watershed's floodplain.
